title: Power BI Dataset Refresh Failures
dataSources: Power BI activity events (`o365:management:activity` with `Workload=PowerBI`), Power BI REST Admin API (`/admin/groups`, `/datasets/refreshes`, `/capacities/refreshables`), on-prem data gateway `Mashup`/`GatewayInfo` logs, Premium capacity metrics.
app: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services / Microsoft 365 (`Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices`) for the Power BI activity log; Power BI REST Admin API and on-prem data gateway logs via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=powerbi:admin:refreshes
| stats count as runs, sum(eval(status="Failed")) as failures, latest(serviceExceptionJson) as last_error by datasetId, datasetName
| eval failure_rate=round(100*failures/runs,1)
| where failures>0
| sort - failure_rate
description: Pulls scheduled dataset-refresh history from the Power BI Admin API and ranks datasets by refresh failure rate, exposing the reports serving stale data.
value: A failed Power BI refresh means every report on that dataset shows yesterday's numbers; ranking by failure rate directs attention to the highest-impact datasets.
implementation: Poll the REST Admin `/datasets/refreshes` endpoint via a scripted HEC input; schedule hourly and alert when failures occur for business-critical datasets.
visualization: Table of dataset by failure_rate, timechart of failures, alert.

references.title: Power BI — Track user activities (audit log)

grandmaExplanation: We watch the scheduled data updates behind your Power BI reports and tell you when one fails so a report does not quietly show old numbers.
